newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS warns of domestic flight price hikes.
newsitem.headline: SAS warns of domestic flight price hikes.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System(SAS) warned on Wednesday of price rises on its Danish domestic flights if new government passenger taxes on air travel were passed by parliament.
"Our calculations show that passenger volume will drop by 10-15 percent if the legislation goes through," SAS said in a statement.

It said that it would increase domestic flight single fares by 35 crowns to compensate for the loss of revenue that the proposed legislation would cause on top of rises caused by the planned government tax.
"The alternative would be to cut departures and that would not be popular with our customers, who are demanding hourly flight departures on domestic routes," SAS said.

In early May, the Danish government announced a two billion crown package of economic measures including unspecified new passenger taxes on domestic air travel and increased taxes on overseas air travel. --Joern Nurkka, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969655
